data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Miqah, which means 'who is like God?'. Mycah signifies 'God is my help' or 'Who is like God?'. In the Bible, there are several characters named Mycah, most notably the servant of King Ahaziah and the father of the prophet Samuel. The name Mycah carries the meaning “God is my help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mycah usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In modern times, the name Mycah has been used in various Christian cultures, particularly in the context of biblical names and saint names.
